title: Without AP/AR Data access the vendor Credit Terms field stays hidden
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: A user who can create and edit vendors but has no AP/AR Data access adds and edits a vendor.
  • You are signed in as {User-A}, on a custom role, {Role-A}, with the vendor permissions to create and edit vendors but not View and Manage AP/AR Data.
    For example: {User-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S6-08 User and {Role-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S6-08 No APAR.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} exists.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S6-08 Vendor.
  • Starting screen: Parts, Vendors.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Vendor".
  2. Close the window.
  3. Open Edit Vendor for {Vendor-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Vendor" window opens. "Credit Terms" does not show, as today.
  • Step 2: the window closes.
  • Step 3: "Credit Terms" does not show.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-N1: “If the user does not have the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' setting, the vendor Credit Terms field stays hidden, as today.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “The Credit Terms and Credit Limit fields on New Customer and Edit Customer, and the Credit Terms field on New Vendor and Edit Vendor, are governed by 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', as the existing Edit fields are.”
